router.embedding_spaces.rules: Read-only bounded persistent embedding-space inventory and revisioned explicit selection. Status is derived from host-owned qualification evidence and current connection/account/model/endpoint/config identity. No space is inferred from a conversation or first route. Historical identity is retained when unavailable. Cursor binds inventory and selection snapshot. Dimensions are 1..65536; candidate identity excludes display names and pricing metadata.

notes.format: Merge the new types/operation/schema revision into canonical domain-spec; merge RouterConfigAction.variants and add real whole-variant introducedVariants gating support (name negotiable). Do not replace existing variants/variantSince or rewrite schema1/2.
notes.configureRules: Only actual current Human may create candidates, queue qualification, select a current positively qualified candidate, or clear selection. Create validates exact connection revision and complete current discovered Embedding model. Changed semantic config creates new immutable space identity. Qualify persists exact request/operation/source authority before effect; configure.prepare never performs inference. Replays reuse exact original accounted probe; malformed, incomplete, cancelled, unknown, stale or failed outcomes never qualify/select. Positive evidence comes from actual native journals, immutable result manifest/vector hashes, finite dimension-checked output and nonzero Cosine norm. Selection and candidate revisions are separately fenced. No automatic selection/fallback; old vectors never change identity.
notes.check: CreateEmbeddingSpace.dimensions must reject >65536 in canonical/native Check, not only in business owner.
notes.legacy: Compare all prior schema1/2 bytes including configure input/results and preserve existing56 qualified aliases.
